messages:
sara-support: Heads up — Acme escalated, their org org_acme_42 shows almost no guest/external collaborator usage in the Console charts since 2026-03-10. Customer says visualizations are zeros but activity exists.
acme-cs: Confirmed. We saw active sessions yesterday. Dashboard shows 0 for 'Guest' role and queries to the analytics API return empty arrays. Attaching a screenshot.
sara-support: Can you paste the exact API call you used? Also which timeframe/filters?
acme-cs: We run: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood-inference/v1/orgs/org_acme_42/analytics/usage?start=2026-03-09&end=2026-03-10&role=guest"``` Response: ```200 {
  "data": [],
  "meta": {"interval": "1h"}
}```
sara-support: thx. I tried same call and got same empty result. Filing internal triage.
josh-eng: pinging eng infra + analytics. Did we run the retention migration last night? I remember a change to role retention keys.
priya-product: We rolled a schema migration at 03:12 UTC that renamed per-role retention from `retention_days` -> `data_retention_days` to align with policy service. That should have been backward compatible, but @josh-eng flagged a warning in the migration run.
josh-eng: looking at svc-analytics logs: `WARN analytics.store: unknown field 'data_retention_days' for RoleConfig; defaulting ttl=0` — that would cause the store to treat guest roles as expired and return empty aggregates.
aaron-oncall: metrics-bot shows migration job `role-retention-migration` ran at 03:12:08 UTC and finished with exit code 0 but with 42 warnings.
metrics-bot: [alert] job=role-retention-migration finished. warnings=42, affected_orgs=[org_acme_42, org_beta_7, ...]
priya-product: Okay, root cause looks like incompatible schema read in analytics. We missed adding a compatibility shim for the new field name. Short-term fix: patch svc-analytics to check both `retention_days` and `data_retention_days`. Longer-term: backfill any roles that got a zero TTL.
josh-eng: I can push a hotfix to svc-analytics to read both keys and treat missing as null instead of 0. That should make historical data visible again within ~5–10m after caches expire. Deploying to canary now.
aaron-oncall: Steps to repro/verify: 1) call analytics API with `role=guest` for org_acme_42 2) check svc-analytics logs for `defaulting ttl=0` entries 3) run bq query to find roles with `retention_days IS NULL` and `data_retention_days IS NOT NULL` 4) after patch, confirm API returns non-empty arrays. I'll add runbook notes.
sara-support: Acme — we have an engineer on it and a patch going to canary. ETA 20–30m. Will update you asap. Apologies for the disruption.
acme-cs: Appreciate the quick response. Please let us know when charts repopulate — we need these metrics for a weekly exec review.
priya-product: Follow-up plan: (a) hotfix to accept both fields (b) backfill TTL for affected roles where data still exists (c) add migration validation to catch warnings as failures (d) add unit/integration test for schema rename.
josh-eng: Hotfix deployed to canary; logs look cleaner now. Example after fix: ```INFO analytics.store: role=guest org=org_acme_42 ttl=365``` API call now returns data arrays.
sara-support: Re-checking dashboard — charts beginning to show numbers for guest roles in the 03:00–06:00 window.
acme-cs: Verified on our side — charts repopulated. Thanks everyone.
aaron-oncall: Marking incident as triaged, will keep monitoring for 24h. Filed follow-up ticket PROD-4612 for backfill and migration guardrails.
priya-product: Adding a note to release board to avoid similar renames without compatibility.
sara-support: Closing loop with customer and adding timeline + RCA. Thanks team :heart:
_meta: Generated synthetic Slack thread for support escalation about role-based retention/schema rename causing missing guest analytics. Document follows Redwood slack thread format; contains root message + replies in chronological order.
